resolution.note: Conventions path from the repo contract (default .krn/conventions.json), adopt seeds it from AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, ADR 0002 names it a conventions packet, temporal validity enforced and tested. Proof run: adopt fixture packet non-empty, superseded-record test. Outside Scope: scripts/boundaries.ts (adopt->brain, brain->repo layers).

title: The brain packet reads repo conventions from the repo contract and is named for what it is
body:
Why: memory audit 2026-11-13: src/brain/worker-packet.ts:51 reads the fixed path evals/fr40/records.json, so an adopted repository gets an empty packet; the 19 records are hand-written repo conventions with valid_to always null and no write path (ADR 0002 marks the temporal brain unbuilt). Measured value is real but is convention injection (FR-40 lanes +22.6 pp, n=133, in-sample).
Outcome: the records path comes from the repo contract (default .krn/conventions.json), adopt seeds it from the repository's instruction files, the packet is documented as a conventions packet, and the temporal fields are either enforced (a superseded record never enters a packet) or removed.
Proof: adopt on a fixture repo yields a non-empty packet; a superseded-record test.
Scope: src/brain/, src/adopt/, src/repo/, docs/adr/, test/.
